name: Cutix Plc
source: NGX (doclib.ngxgroup.com) | Group column, audited consolidated and separate statement of profit or loss for the year ended 30 April 2025, printed page 41, and the audited five years financial summary, group column, printed page 81 (_ngx_pdf/CUTIX.pdf). FY2023, FY2022 and FY2021 are group summary picks in thousands of naira: Profit before taxation 1,191,520 / 1,157,641 / 899,827 and Profit after taxation 789,985 / 786,306 / 594,023, each tying to the stored Taxation charge for the same year (1,191,520 less 401,535 = 789,985). FY2025 and FY2024 Profit before taxation were corrected from 456,240 and 511,136 (values that reproduce only as Net Profit plus the stored negative Taxation figure, an inverted sign) to the printed audited 1,609,507 and 1,619,220. FY2025 Net Profit was corrected from 1,033,917 to the printed Profit for the Year 1,031,830, which the stored EPS of 0.146456 multiplied by 7,045,288,000 shares independently reproduces.

rows.label: Income Tax
rows.sign_normalized: negated to the dataset convention: stored with a negative sign, which broke the printed identity Profit Before Tax - Income Tax = Net Profit; the magnitude is unchanged and the column now carries the positive cost sign the identity requires

rows.label: Gross Profit

rows.source: CUTIX Plc audited consolidated and separate statement of profit or loss for the year ended 30 April 2025, group column, printed page 41 (file _ngx_pdf/CUTIX.pdf page index 40). source_note: Q1 FY2027 column from the company filing (https://doclib.ngxgroup.com/Financial_NewsDocs/47857_CUTIX_PLC.-_QUARTER_1_-_FINANCIAL_STATEMENT_FOR_2027_FINANCIAL_STATEMENTS_AUGUST_2026.pdf): revenue, profit after tax and EPS only; other lines blank because the release did not state them. UNIT CHECK: values whose magnitude did not reconcile with the annual column were withheld (filing unit differed from the statement unit); they were not rescaled. UNIT APPLIED: figures converted x1000 from the unit stated in the filing (e.g. Kshs '000). Conversion only where the result reconciles with the annual column. MAGNITUDE: a period figure that was less than 5 percent of the prior annual column was withheld as unit-suspect; it is blank rather than rescaled.
